sources.entry: AI Novel Writer - Open-source AI writing workspace for organizing characters, worldbuilding, outlines, chapters, review, and revision in one novel project. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Pagekin (书童, formerly AI Novel Writer), a free open-source desktop app that uses your own API key or local Ollama models to help write, review, and revise long-form novels chapter by chapter.
summary.what_it_does: The app walks through a novel's workflow: settings, story structure (premise, character list, worldbuilding, plot outline), chapter blueprints, then drafting, AI review, revision with paragraph-by-paragraph diffs, and finalizing. It can also deconstruct a reference novel (.txt, .md, .epub) to imitate its style, import your own manuscript to continue it, and rewrite selected passages (polish, expand, or convert to dialogue). It tracks characters with relationship graphs, plot threads and foreshadowing, and keeps per-chapter version history. Projects are stored locally in a folder plus SQLite, with export to Markdown or TXT and backup to a user-bound WebDAV server. Users can install prompt-only writing Skills (SKILL.md files) from a local folder or GitHub URL, after reviewing the content.
use_cases: drafting a long novel or web serial chapter by chapter
planning characters, worldbuilding and chapter outlines
getting AI review and revision feedback on a manuscript
continuing an existing manuscript with AI
imitating the style of a reference novel
running a local LLM for private fiction writing
exporting or backing up a novel project
how_to_run: Download the official installer from GitHub Releases (Windows x64, or macOS arm64/x64 DMG)
Open Settings and enter a provider preset or custom base URL, model name, and API key (or point to a local Ollama server)
Create a new project in the 书房 (study) and fill in settings and architecture
Build a chapter blueprint, then use 写第 N 章 to draft each chapter
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd AI-Novel-Writer, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm dev (Node.js 22.14+ and pnpm required)
notable: Local-first: projects stored on your own computer; the app ships no models and no hosted account
Chapter pipeline in one page: draft, review with checkable opinions, revise via per-paragraph diff, finalize
Imports a reference novel to extract structure and style, or a manuscript to continue from
Installable prompt-only writing Skills, with the content shown for inspection before installation
Bilingual UI (Chinese and English) with light and dark themes
caveats: Windows installer is not code-signed; macOS builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so Gatekeeper warnings are expected
Only OpenAI-compatible and Gemini protocols are supported; arbitrary third-party APIs and Anthropic/Azure/KoboldAI native APIs are not guaranteed
The assistant chat entry is hidden in version 1.3.0; the bundled DeepSeek Harness web plugin is frozen and far less capable than the desktop app
keywords: help me draft a novel with ai
